title: Pipeline module input specification
description: Machine-readable contract for the `pipeline` OpenTofu module inputs. Derived from `infra/modules/pipeline/variables.tf` (types, validations, defaults). Agents use this schema to validate a generated pipeline specification before writing files (`pipeline.yaml`, `inputs.tfvars`). Sibling schema `schemas/pipeline.schema.json` describes the `pipeline.yaml` on-disk shape; this schema describes the module boundary itself and stays in sync with `variables.tf`.

initialization.description: Configuration object from the pipeline-initialization module. Contains shared context (pipeline_name, environment, region, tags), bucket names/KMS key, SSM and Secrets Manager configuration.

names.description: Map of bucket role to bucket name. The `intermediate` key is mandatory (see `variables.tf` validation).

steps.description: Ordered list of pipeline steps. Regular step types: `batch`, `lambda`. Special type: `parallel` — contains a nested `parallel_steps` list of compute steps run inside a Step Functions Map state. At most one parallel block is allowed per pipeline.

capacity_provider.description: Capacity provider for AWS Batch. `FARGATE` for on-demand, `FARGATE_SPOT` for cost-optimized spot.

max_vcpus.description: AWS Batch maximum vcpus across all running jobs. `variables.tf` enforces `< 257`.

vpc_id.description: VPC ID for the Batch compute environment.

subnet_ids.description: Subnet IDs for the Batch compute environment. Use at least two for AZ redundancy.

cw_retention_days.description: Shared value for CloudWatch Logs retention days. Must be between 15 and 730 (matches the module's OpenTofu validation).

ecr_force_delete.description: ECR delete even if images are present. Set `true` only in dev.

ecr_scan_on_push.description: Enable Amazon ECR basic scanning on image push.

ecr_keep_tagged_count.description: Keep the N most recently pushed tagged images (in addition to `latest`). `null` disables the rule.

ecr_expire_untagged_days.description: Expire untagged ECR images after this many days. `null` disables.

ecr_archive_unpulled_days.description: Transition ECR images to archive storage when not pulled for this many days. `null` disables.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrency for the parallel Map step. `0` means unlimited.

copy_to_target_ecr_url.description: ECR URL for the copy-intermediate-to-output container. Read from SSM by callers.

pipeline_completion_emails.description: Email addresses subscribed to the pipeline completion SNS topic.

lambda_steps_code_path.description: Absolute path to the directory containing lambda step subdirectories. Callers must pass an absolute path using `path.module`.

sg_compute_additional.description: Additional egress rules for the batch/lambda compute security groups.

additional_tags.description: Additional tags applied to every resource created by the module.

allOf.description: At most one parallel block is allowed (validation: `length([for step in var.steps : step if step.type == "parallel"]) <= 1`).

step_name.description: Alphanumeric and underscores only. Becomes an ECR repo suffix, a Step Functions state name, a `code/<step>/` directory, and the state key `$.<name>_result`. No hyphens — S3/ECR naming rules downstream.

runtime_parameters.description: Key-value pairs passed as env vars (batch) or payload fields (lambda) from the execution input. Values must be non-empty strings.

ecr_repository_url.description: External ECR repository URL. Omit (or set null) to have the module create a dedicated repo `<pipeline>-<env>-<step>`.

copy_to_target.description: Copy this step's intermediate output to the `output` bucket after the pipeline completes. Requires the `output` bucket in `initialization.buckets.names`.

lambda_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Lambda hard-caps at 900.

parallel_step.description: Step Functions Map block. `variables.tf` requires `parallel_steps` non-empty and `input` present; `input.type` must be `s3` or `custom`; if `input.from_step` is set it must reference a preceding compute step; `custom` + `from_step` requires `field`; nested steps must be `batch` or `lambda`.

from_step.description: Name of a preceding `batch` or `lambda` step whose output supplies the fan-out data.

root_prefix.description: S3 prefix for discovery (`type=s3`). With `from_step` defaults to `<execution_id>/<from_step>/`.

field.description: Dot-notation field in the referenced step's output (`type=custom` with `from_step`).

parallel_steps.description: Compute steps to run inside the Map. Only `batch` or `lambda`.
